exam_scheme.note: Telangana State Integrated Common Entrance Test (TG ICET) is conducted as a Computer Based Test (CBT) by Mahatma Gandhi University, Nalgonda on behalf of the Telangana Council of Higher Education (TGCHE) for admission into Master of Business Administration (MBA) and Master of Computer Applications (MCA) postgraduate professional degree programmes. The test comprises 200 multiple-choice questions carrying 200 marks of 150 minutes (2 hours 30 minutes) duration across three sections: Section A Analytical Ability (75 marks), Section B Mathematical Ability (75 marks), and Section C Communication Ability (50 marks). Each question carries 1 mark with no negative marking. The qualifying mark is 25% (50 marks out of 200) for General and BC candidates; no minimum qualifying mark is prescribed for candidates belonging to SC and ST categories. Merit ranks are allotted based on normalized marks across test sessions.

papers.qualifying_threshold: 25% aggregate marks (50 out of 200) across all three sections for General/BC candidates; no minimum for SC/ST

papers.qualifying_threshold: 25% aggregate marks (50 out of 200) across all three sections for General/BC candidates; no minimum for SC/ST

papers.qualifying_threshold: 25% aggregate marks (50 out of 200) across all three sections for General/BC candidates; no minimum for SC/ST
